title: 0x80070005 – Access Denied
fix: Run as administrator and verify NTFS permissions.

title: 0x80004005 – Unspecified Error
fix: Restart system and check Windows Updates.

title: 0x80070057 – Invalid Parameter
fix: Run sfc /scannow and check disk integrity.

title: 0x8024402C – Windows Update Error
fix: Check proxy settings and reset Windows Update components.

title: Blue Screen – CRITICAL_PROCESS_DIED
fix: Run system file check and update drivers.

title: Application Not Responding
fix: End task and reinstall application if recurring.

title: DLL File Missing
fix: Reinstall application or restore from system backup.

title: Windows Activation Error 0xC004F074
fix: Check network and run activation command again.

title: DNS Server Not Responding
fix: Switch to 8.8.8.8 or flush DNS cache.

title: VPN Not Connecting
fix: Verify credentials and check firewall rules.

title: Network Path Not Found
fix: Verify server name and network connectivity.

title: Printer Offline
fix: Restart printer and verify WiFi connection.

title: Teams Microphone Not Working
fix: Enable microphone access in privacy settings.

title: Laptop Overheating
cause: Dust buildup or high CPU usage.
fix: Clean vents and check task manager.

title: Hard Drive Not Detected
cause: Loose SATA cable or disk failure.

title: 0x80072EFD – Cannot Connect to Server
fix: Disable proxy temporarily and verify firewall settings.

title: 0xC000021A – Fatal System Error
fix: Boot into safe mode and uninstall recent updates.

title: 0x0000007B – Inaccessible Boot Device
fix: Check BIOS settings and disk health.

title: Taskbar Not Responding
fix: Restart Windows Explorer from Task Manager.

title: Black Screen After Login
fix: Boot in safe mode and update display drivers.

title: BitLocker Recovery Required
fix: Enter recovery key from Microsoft account.

title: Remote Desktop Cannot Connect
fix: Enable Remote Desktop and check firewall.

title: Hostname Cannot Be Resolved
fix: Check DNS settings and flush cache.

title: Printer Queue Stuck
fix: Clear spooler queue and restart service.

title: Cannot Print PDF
fix: Open and print from another PDF reader.

title: Default Printer Keeps Changing
fix: Disable 'Let Windows manage my default printer'.

title: Account Expired
fix: Extend account validity in Active Directory.

title: Cannot Join Domain
fix: Verify DNS points to domain controller.

title: Bluetooth Not Working
fix: Enable Bluetooth service and update drivers.

title: USB Device Not Recognized
fix: Try another USB port and update drivers.

title: 0x80070570 – File or Directory Corrupted
cause: Corrupted file system or bad sectors.
fix: Run chkdsk /f /r on the affected drive.

title: 0x80070103 – Driver Update Failed
fix: Hide update or install latest driver manually.

title: 0x00000050 – PAGE_FAULT_IN_NONPAGED_AREA
fix: Run memory diagnostics and update drivers.

title: 0x0000009F – DRIVER_POWER_STATE_FAILURE
cause: Driver not responding during sleep transition.

title: High CPU Usage
fix: Check Task Manager and disable startup apps.

title: Gateway Not Available
fix: Restart router and reset network adapter.

title: User Profile Cannot Be Loaded
fix: Create new profile and transfer data.

title: Group Policy Not Applying
fix: Run gpupdate /force and verify domain connectivity.

title: INACCESSIBLE_BOOT_DEVICE
fix: Boot into recovery and repair startup.

title: SSL Certificate Error
fix: Update system time or renew certificate.

title: Port Already in Use
fix: Identify process with netstat and stop it.

title: Printer IP Conflict
fix: Assign static IP outside DHCP range.

title: OneDrive Sync Error
fix: Sign out and sign in again.

title: Camera Not Detected
fix: Enable camera access in privacy settings.

title: Temporary Profile Loaded
fix: Fix registry profile path or create new profile.

title: Blue Screen – ATTEMPTED_WRITE_TO_READONLY_MEMORY
cause: Driver attempted to write to protected memory.
fix: Update or uninstall the problematic driver.

title: Blue Screen – KERNEL_DATA_INPAGE_ERROR
cause: Hard drive or paging file corruption.
fix: Run chkdsk and check disk health.

title: Blue Screen – NTFS_FILE_SYSTEM
fix: Run chkdsk /f and repair disk errors.

title: Blue Screen – THREAD_STUCK_IN_DEVICE_DRIVER
cause: Graphics driver stuck in infinite loop.

title: Blue Screen – KERNEL_MODE_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED
fix: Update drivers and check hardware compatibility.

title: Windows Update Error 0x80070020
cause: File in use during update process.

title: Ethernet Connected But No Network Access
Printer Printing Slowly
fix: Reduce print quality or restart spooler.

title: Printer Paper Size Mismatch
cause: Paper size different from driver settings.

title: CPU Temperature Too High
cause: Cooling fan blocked or dust buildup.
fix: Clean vents and ensure proper airflow.

title: RAM Usage Extremely High
fix: Restart system and check Task Manager.

title: Blue Screen – DATA_BUS_ERROR
cause: Memory access failure caused by faulty RAM.
fix: Run Windows Memory Diagnostic and replace defective RAM.

title: Blue Screen – DRIVER_CORRUPTED_EXPOOL
fix: Update or reinstall the affected driver.

title: Blue Screen – DRIVER_CAUGHT_MODIFYING_FREED_POOL
cause: Driver attempted to modify freed memory.
fix: Update drivers and uninstall problematic software.

title: Blue Screen – SESSION_HAS_VALID_POOL_ON_EXIT
cause: Kernel memory leak caused by faulty driver.
fix: Update drivers and check recent installations.

title: Windows Installer Error 1603
cause: Installation process encountered a fatal error.
fix: Restart system and run installer as administrator.

title: DHCP Lease Expired
cause: Device failed to renew IP address.

title: Router Overloaded
fix: Restart router and reduce connected devices.

title: Network Broadcast Storm
fix: Identify loop and isolate affected device.

title: LAN Port Disabled
cause: Port disabled on switch or router.

title: Printer Fuser Error
fix: Restart printer and replace fuser if needed.

title: Printer Calibration Failed
cause: Sensor unable to align print head.

title: CPU Thermal Throttling
fix: Clean cooling system and apply thermal paste.

title: System Kernel Panic
fix: Boot in Safe Mode and repair system.

title: Secure Boot Violation
fix: Restore secure boot settings in BIOS.

title: Blue Screen – VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE
cause: Graphics driver failed to respond within timeout period.

title: Blue Screen – DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION
cause: Driver taking too long to complete operations.

title: Blue Screen – SYSTEM_SERVICE_EXCEPTION
fix: Update drivers and uninstall recent software.

title: Windows Login Screen Freezing
cause: Corrupt user profile or startup service conflict.
fix: Boot into Safe Mode and disable problematic startup programs.

title: Windows Clipboard Not Working
fix: Restart Windows Explorer or clipboard service.

title: Windows Cannot Detect Second Monitor
cause: Display driver issue or incorrect display configuration.
fix: Update display drivers and detect displays manually.

title: Network Latency Too High
fix: Test network path and restart router.

title: ARP Table Conflict
cause: Incorrect MAC address mapping in ARP table.
fix: Clear ARP cache using arp -d command.

title: NTP Time Synchronization Failed
fix: Change NTP server and verify network connectivity.

title: Network Switch Port Error
cause: Faulty port or cable on switch.
fix: Move cable to another switch port.

title: Gateway Timeout
fix: Restart gateway or check upstream connection.

title: Printer Cannot Detect Paper Tray
fix: Reinsert paper tray and clean sensor.

title: Printer Duplex Unit Error
fix: Disable duplex printing or service unit.

title: Printer Toner Cartridge Not Recognized
fix: Reinsert toner cartridge or replace it.

title: RAM Slot Failure
fix: Test RAM in another slot or replace motherboard.

title: GPU Overheating
fix: Clean GPU fans and ensure proper airflow.

title: NVMe SSD Not Detected
cause: Incorrect BIOS configuration or drive failure.
fix: Enable NVMe support in BIOS and reseat drive.

title: Blue Screen – SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED
cause: Driver generated an exception the system handler did not catch.

title: Blue Screen – UNEXPECTED_KERNEL_MODE_TRAP
cause: CPU generated a trap due to hardware or driver error.

title: Blue Screen – MACHINE_CHECK_EXCEPTION
cause: Critical hardware error detected by CPU.
fix: Check CPU, cooling system, and motherboard.

title: Windows Explorer High Memory Usage
cause: Explorer memory leak caused by shell extension.
fix: Restart Explorer and disable problematic extensions.

title: Windows Defender Real-Time Protection Disabled
fix: Enable real-time protection in Windows Security.

title: Windows File System Read-Only Error
cause: Drive mounted as read-only due to corruption.
fix: Run chkdsk and repair disk errors.

title: DNS Resolution Timeout
cause: DNS server response delayed or unreachable.
fix: Change DNS server and flush cache.

title: Network MTU Mismatch
cause: Incorrect MTU size causing packet fragmentation.
fix: Adjust MTU settings on router or adapter.

title: Wireless Signal Too Weak
cause: Distance from access point or interference.
fix: Move closer to router or reposition access point.

title: Network Port Security Violation
cause: Unauthorized device connected to secured port.
fix: Reset port security settings on switch.

title: DHCP Scope Exhausted
cause: No available IP addresses in DHCP scope.
fix: Expand DHCP scope or release unused leases.

title: Printer Unable to Detect Toner Level
Printer Sleep Mode Not Waking
cause: Firmware bug or power setting issue.
fix: Disable deep sleep mode or update firmware.

title: Printer USB Communication Error
fix: Replace USB cable or change port.

title: Printer Printhead Temperature Error
fix: Power off printer and allow cooling.

title: Hard Drive Clicking Noise
fix: Backup data immediately and replace drive.

title: Laptop Power Jack Loose
fix: Repair or replace DC power jack.

title: Motherboard BIOS Firmware Corrupted
cause: BIOS update failed or firmware corrupted.
fix: Reflash BIOS using manufacturer recovery method.

title: CPU Socket Contact Failure
cause: Bent pins or poor CPU contact.
fix: Inspect CPU socket and reseat processor.

title: RAM Timing Configuration Error
cause: Incorrect RAM timing settings in BIOS.
fix: Reset BIOS memory settings to default.

title: GPU Fan Failure
fix: Replace GPU fan or graphics card.

title: PCIe Power Cable Not Connected
cause: Graphics card missing required power connection.
fix: Connect PCIe power cable from PSU.

title: SSD Firmware Outdated
fix: Update SSD firmware using manufacturer tool.

title: Motherboard USB Header Failure
fix: Use alternate USB header or replace motherboard.

title: Blue Screen – KMODE_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED
fix: Update drivers and check system memory.

title: Blue Screen – SYSTEM_PTE_MISUSE
fix: Update drivers and run memory diagnostics.

title: Blue Screen – PFN_LIST_CORRUPT
fix: Test RAM and update system drivers.

title: Blue Screen – MEMORY_IMAGE_CORRUPT
fix: Run memory diagnostics and reinstall drivers.

title: Windows Update Error 0x8024200D
fix: Clear Windows Update cache and retry.

title: Network Gateway Packet Loss
fix: Restart router or check network load.

title: DHCP Address Conflict
fix: Clear DHCP leases and renew address.

title: Router NAT Table Overflow
fix: Restart router to clear NAT table.

title: Printer Waste Toner Container Full
fix: Replace or empty waste toner container.

title: Printer Internal Memory Error
fix: Restart printer and reduce document size.

title: Printer Network Configuration Lost
cause: Printer reset or network configuration cleared.

title: Printer Duplex Motor Failure
fix: Disable duplex printing or service printer.
